title: Preserve supported header and footer templates and visibility
scope: Map legacy page header/footer templates and visibility to the supported GP8 BinaryStylesheet fields; retain physical geometry as a separate limit.
acceptance: Preserve the supported Title, Subtitle, Artist, Album, Words, Music, WordsAndMusic, Tabber and both Copyright template/visibility fields where present, using exact Header/* and Footer/* keys.
Use pinned GP5 and GP8 header-footer fixtures with distinct non-default templates and visible/hidden fields. Verify public import/edit/export, exact stylesheet records and pinned consumer values.

Define authority between the existing PageSetup templates/bitmask and any richer score-style representation. Split the legacy copyright lines deterministically and report ambiguous or lossy projection instead of discarding text.

Retain explicit template absence/defaults; do not accidentally erase other supported stylesheet values. New alignment APIs are excluded; preserve the documented default alignment for projected legacy fields.
exclusions: Physical dimensions, margins, score-size and page-number templates lack the required retaining GP8 oracle and remain separately reported.
Alignment preservation is not silently promised by template support; existing non-default alignment must have an explicit disposition.

reproduction.instructions: Preserve the supported Title, Subtitle, Artist, Album, Words, Music, WordsAndMusic, Tabber and both Copyright template/visibility fields where present, using exact Header/* and Footer/* keys. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
implementation-ready: Pinned BinaryStylesheet applies and writes header/footer templates and visibility, unlike physical geometry. The shared stylesheet infrastructure is owned by #109.
